question: Should `optimizeImages` forwarding and typed Ogg/duration controls remain durable shared Plugin SDK media options, rather than WhatsApp-private behavior?
rationale: The implementation correctly moves a plugin away from private copies, but deciding which media controls become a stable cross-plugin contract cannot safely be inferred from this PR alone.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Keep the focused SDK additions, rebase onto current `main`, and validate the exact WhatsApp media paths before merge.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Ask for a revised owner-approved abstraction if these controls should not be available through the general media facades.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Defer the branch if the repository does not yet want to commit to this Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep the focused SDK additions, rebase onto current `main`, and validate the exact WhatsApp media paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this member as the active contributor on the WhatsApp/media path; an area owner can use that context to make the API-direction decision.
